prompts.title: Free cash flow
prompts.prompt: Free cash flow for the six months ended June 30, 2026: net cash from operating activities minus capital spending on property and equipment.

prompts.title: Net debt
prompts.prompt: Net debt as of June 30, 2026: all debt, current and non-current, minus cash and cash equivalents on the balance sheet date.

prompts.title: Gross margin check
prompts.prompt: Gross margin check for the nine months ended September 27, 2026: recompute gross margin from total net sales and total cost of sales, and compare it with the printed gross margin.

prompts.title: Capex intensity
prompts.prompt: Capex intensity for the six months ended June 30, 2026: capital spending on property and equipment as a share of revenues.

prompts.title: Adjusted vs reported gap
prompts.prompt: Adjusted vs reported gap for the six months ended June 30, 2026: the difference between adjusted operating income and the reported operating loss it starts from.
